The paper proposes a new method for joint feature selection and classification of longitudinal/functional data with categorical responses, formulating an optimization that integrates logistic loss and functional features to identify key predictors. Computationally, it uses functional principal components and an adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm that exploits sparsity for dimensionality reduction, enabling scalable analysis in high-dimensional settings and demonstrating effectiveness in simulations and a real study of chronic diseases.
